name: markdown-preview
description: MCP server for markdown to PDF/HTML/PNG conversion. PDF engine: @amitdevx/md2pdf (Chromium/Playwright) — renders Mermaid, KaTeX, and syntax highlighting natively. Supports callouts, TOC, page numbers, outline/bookmarks, running header/footer, custom header/footer templates, auto-numbered figure/table captions (Gambar N./Tabel N.), and 21 themes (16 plugin themes + 5 md2pdf built-ins) plus custom CSS themes. markdown_to_pdf accepts toc, tocDepth, tocPageBreak, h1NewPage, hrPageBreak, outline, paper, margin, fontSize, lineHeight, header, footer, headerTemplate, footerTemplate, autoNumberCaptions. Exposes 3 tools: markdown_to_pdf, markdown_to_html, markdown_to_png.
